findings.title: MD5 usage
findings.description: MD5 is cryptographically broken and should not be used for security-sensitive hashing.
findings.recommendation: Use a modern cryptographic hash such as SHA-256 or SHA-3 where appropriate.

findings.title: Hard-coded API key

findings.title: Hard-coded secret

findings.title: Hard-coded encryption key

findings.recommendation: Rotate the key and store cryptographic keys using secure key management.

findings.title: DES usage
